title: Chrome embedding: the module's state snapshot (stage B)
description: What mountSurface's handle reports as `state` (a frozen snapshot, read at any time) and what each `onSignal` call carries whole (08 C-08.24). The field names are stage A's status message (08-frame-message.json $defs/status) so a shell written against the frame reads the module without translation; `key` and the version pair are the module's own. Display only: the shell acts on the hub's own index, never on this.

chat.description: The chat this instance is mounted on.

conn.description: The socket's state as the frame's status reports it, plus refused: the module did not connect because the surface is outside options.compat (C-08.30); versions.surface and versions.surface_protocol say what it found.

chat_state.description: As the frame's status defines it (unknown and any unrecognised word fold to idle); absent until the first mirror snapshot on a live socket.

active_node.description: The active node's label (the graph's, until pages replace it under 01 and 02).

node_label.description: The node on screen, under stage A's name (08-frame-message.json status.node_label); equals active_node unless previewing. The topbar's pill is not in the module.

title.description: The page title, agent-written: text only.

auth.description: refused once a request or the socket, admitted before, was answered 401, or 403 without a JSON body (C-08.15; the daemon's own 403s carry a JSON refusal and stay forbidden); the shell re-signs in or re-mints and mounts again.

key.description: On an onSignal call made for a reserved chord, made at once outside the throttle: that chord, spelt as chordOf spells it on validChord's grammar with an optional Mod+ (C-08.23, C-08.24). Null on every other call and in `state`.

module.description: The web-chat release the module is built from: the hub's dependency's package version (12 ./package.json), the module's one version number (C-08.26).

surface.description: The surface's web-chat release (GET /api/health package_version), once read; null before.

surface_protocol.description: The surface protocol the surface reports (GET /api/health surface_protocol; 1 when the field is absent), once read; null before. Optional.

protocol.description: The surface protocol the module speaks (lib/core/versions.js SURFACE_PROTOCOL_VERSION, 1 at its first release; health reports it as surface_protocol, absent means 1). Never PROTOCOL_VERSION, the capture hub's self-heal counter health reports as version (versions.js:47, routes/health.js:93-95). The skew rule is C-08.30's.
